description: "We are a team of Year 7 students from Dubai joining the Universal Event! We love space, coding, and technology The challenge we are doing is the space mission design game.We are taking the NASA Space Apps Challenge seriously and want to build something awesome, while having a great time working together as a squad. Our 2 people team is ready to go!
summary: Planetfall is a free browser game where players act as NASA mission directors. Users design a spacecraft within budget, weight, and power limits to orbit Mars, Venus, or Jupiter. During flight, players manage battery power during eclipses, handle unexpected space events, and downlink science data when Earth is in view. This game makes complex space engineering fun and hands-on, helping students build problem-solving skills and inspiring future careers in STEM and space exploration.
details: Planetfall is a browser-based space simulator built on Rosebud AI where players act as NASA flight directors. Players build a spacecraft within budget, weight, and power limits to orbit Mars, Venus, or Jupiter, managing eclipses, emergencies, and Earth data downlinks using real NASA planetary and Deep Space Network science.
dataRefs: NASA Eyes on the Solar System
projectRefs: Rosebud AI — Game creation platform used to build Planetfall
